achievements.name: First Victory
achievements.detail: Win a battle by choosing each party member's action when that character's turn arrives.

achievements.name: Field Attack
achievements.detail: Strike a weaker monster on the field and defeat it before a normal battle begins.

achievements.name: Shrine Portal
achievements.detail: Assemble stone fragments at the Shrine of Mysteries and travel through the portal they open.

achievements.name: Island Restored
achievements.detail: Settle a lost land's trouble in the past so that island returns to the present ocean.

achievements.name: New Vocation
achievements.detail: Change a character into a vocation and use the perk that comes with it.

achievements.name: Moonlighting
achievements.detail: Assign one character two vocations at once and use skills drawn from both.

achievements.name: Let Loose
achievements.detail: Work a character up in battle and fire that vocation's Let Loose perk.

achievements.name: Full Company
achievements.detail: Travel with a full party and swap the reserve member in during a battle.

achievements.name: Mini Medal
achievements.detail: Turn a Mini Medal in at the exchange and claim a prize from the counter.

achievements.name: Arena Bout
achievements.detail: Enter the battle arena and win a bout against its lineup.

achievements.name: Metal Hunt
achievements.detail: Defeat a metal monster before it can run away.

achievements.name: Deep Pockets
achievements.detail: Save up a fortune of 300,000 gold.

achievements.name: Vocation Master
achievements.detail: Raise every vocation to its highest rank.
